title: Seagrove "Our Happy Place" 177 San Roy Rd
h1: Seagrove "Our Happy Place" 177 San Roy Rd
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf-front with large private beach- Private pool with sitting spa **Pool heating is available October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $90 per day.- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 4 beach chairs and 2 umbrellas (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31) - Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Sprawling porches- 5 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Dedicated parking for 4 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Unparalleled Gulf views and luxury abound at Our Happy Place, an exquisite Seagrove Beach home offering 5 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, and exceptional accommodations for 16 guests. Boasting a sprawling deck with beach access and a Gulf-front private pool, this property is the ultimate coastal escape.Splashes of art, sculptural lighting, and breathtaking beach views add color and playfulness to the elegant atmosphere found inside this contemporary property. The main level’s spacious, open-concept floor plan offers wonderful flow for mingling with loved ones. Premium appliances and ample counter space in the gourmet kitchen encourage delicious vacation meals. The adjacent dining area includes a wet bar and a vast dining table for 10 guests, with 4 additional seats at the nearby breakfast bar. In the adjoining living room, a stunning vaulted ceiling evokes a feel of grandeur as guests relax on the plush furnishings to watch TV. Sliding glass doors lead to the expansive porch, outfitted with comfortable seating for enjoying views of the turquoise waters and a staircase to the lower deck. Retreat for a peaceful night in the lavish primary and 2 guest bedrooms, each featuring an indulgent king bed and a private bathroom. The delightful bunk room includes a queen-over-king bunk bed.On the first floor, a cheerful living area with a wet bar provides extra space for lounging, while the neighboring workout studio boasts a Peloton bike for exhilarating exercise, and a separate office makes it easy to mix work with play. Outside, savor the lustrous Gulf views and unwind in the inviting private pool and sitting spa. Cushioned seating in the shade and an alfresco table invite guests to spend every possible moment in the sweet coastal breeze. When the surf beckons, simply open the gate and step down to the beach below. A guest bedroom featuring a soft king bed and a private bathroom is tucked on this level.Revel in an incredible Seagrove beach vacation at Our Happy Place. On-site parking and 5 complimentary adult bikes provide the perfect way to experience the sights and sounds of 30A. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 16):FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower Only- Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa and Sectional Sofa can be Converted to Two Twin Beds.SECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-King Bunk Bed, Shared Bath with Shower/Tub Combo

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seagrove "Our Happy Place" 177 San Roy Rd Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 5 Beds 9 Sleeps 16 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf-front with large private beach - Private pool with sitting spa **Pool heating is available October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $90 per day. - Complimentary beach setups each morning include 4 beach chairs and 2 umbrellas (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31) - Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity - Sprawling porches - 5 adult bikes - 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Dedicated parking for 4 vehicles - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Unparalleled Gulf views and luxury abound at Our Happy Place, an exquisite Seagrove Beach home offering 5 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, and exceptional accommodations for 16 guests. Boasting a sprawling deck with beach access and a Gulf-front private pool, this property is the ultimate coastal escape. Splashes of art, sculptural lighting, and breathtaking beach views add color and playfulness to the elegant atmosphere found inside this contemporary property. The main level’s spacious, open-concept floor plan offers wonderful flow for mingling with loved ones. Premium appliances and ample counter space in the gourmet kitchen encourage delicious vacation meals. The adjacent dining area includes a wet bar and a vast dining table for 10 guests, with 4 additional seats at the nearby breakfast bar. In the adjoining living room, a stunning vaulted ceiling evokes a feel of grandeur as guests relax on the plush furnishings to watch TV. Sliding glass doors lead to the expansive porch, outfitted with comfortable seating for enjoying views of the turquoise waters and a staircase to the lower deck. Retreat for a peaceful night in the lavish primary and 2 guest bedrooms, each featuring an indulgent king bed and a private bathroom. The delightful bunk room includes a queen-over-king bunk bed. On the first floor, a cheerful living area with a wet bar provides extra space for lounging, while the neighboring workout studio boasts a Peloton bike for exhilarating exercise, and a separate office makes it easy to mix work with play. Outside, savor the lustrous Gulf views and unwind in the inviting private pool and sitting spa. Cushioned seating in the shade and an alfresco table invite guests to spend every possible moment in the sweet coastal breeze. When the surf beckons, simply open the gate and step down to the beach below. A guest bedroom featuring a soft king bed and a private bathroom is tucked on this level. Revel in an incredible Seagrove beach vacation at Our Happy Place. On-site parking and 5 complimentary adult bikes provide the perfect way to experience the sights and sounds of 30A. Book today!
